_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "sex" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("sex" IN ('male', 'female')), "birth_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "training_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "training_days_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "profile_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "daily_activity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'light', "goal_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_system" TEXT NOT NULL, "onboarded_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "body_fat_percent" REAL NULL, "requested_loss_fraction" REAL NULL, "pregnant" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pregnant" IN (0, 1)), "breastfeeding" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("breastfeeding" IN (0, 1)), "eating_disorder_history" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("eating_disorder_history" IN (0, 1)), "chronic_kidney_disease" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("chronic_kidney_disease" IN (0, 1)), "androgen_use" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("androgen_use" IN (0, 1)), "pcos" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pcos" IN (0, 1)), "menopause" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("menopause" IN (0, 1)), "thyroid_condition" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("thyroid_condition" IN (0, 1)), "insulin_or_sulfonylurea" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("insulin_or_sulfonylurea" IN (0, 1)), "insulin_care_team_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("insulin_care_team_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "bariatric_surgery" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("bariatric_surgery" IN (0, 1)), "weight_affecting_medication" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("weight_affecting_medication" IN (0, 1)), "health_check_confirmed_epoch_day" INTEGER NULL, "health_check_skip_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "creatine_started_epoch_day" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_entries" ("epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_kg" BETWEEN 20.0 AND 500.0), "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("epoch_day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kcal" >= 0.0), "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g" >= 0.0), "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g" >= 0.0), "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g" >= 0.0), "quantity_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "portion_quantity" REAL NULL CHECK("portion_quantity" > 0.0), "portion_unit" TEXT NULL, "nutrition_basis" TEXT NULL, "reference_basis" TEXT NULL, "reference_kcal" REAL NULL, "reference_protein_g" REAL NULL, "reference_carbs_g" REAL NULL, "reference_fat_g" REAL NULL, "serving_description" TEXT NULL, "serving_grams" REAL NULL, "serving_milliliters" REAL NULL, "serving_unit" TEXT NULL, "density_g_per_ml" REAL NULL, "origin_pack_id" TEXT NULL, "origin_food_id" INTEGER NULL, "origin_source" TEXT NULL, "origin_source_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_marks" ("epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completeness" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("epoch_day"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "waist_entries" ("epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("waist_cm" BETWEEN 30.0 AND 300.0), PRIMARY KEY ("epoch_day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "targets_history" ("effective_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_minimum_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "weekly_rate_fraction" REAL NOT NULL, "flags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "tdee_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "tdee_sigma_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "explanation" TEXT NULL, "summary_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("summary_seen" IN (0, 1)), "target_rules_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "profile_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "safety_body_fat_percent" REAL NULL, "tdee_status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("effective_epoch_day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_preferences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "theme_preference" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "easy_to_miss_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("easy_to_miss_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "easy_to_miss_last_shown_epoch_day" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_events" ("date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date_epoch_day", "type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_foods" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_description" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_grams" REAL NULL CHECK("serving_grams" > 0.0), "kcal" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kcal" >= 0.0), "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g" >= 0.0), "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g" >= 0.0), "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g" >= 0.0), "barcode" TEXT NULL, "servings" REAL NULL, "cooked_weight_grams" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recipe_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" REAL NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL);
